rationale: The description states that scheduling, triggers, script tasks, and file-transfer, encryption, compression, and transformation integrations automate jobs; these are conventional workflow functions without an affirmative AI signal.
evidence_spans: VisualCron combines many features into one product. Through scheduling you can set your Jobs to run on a specific time or event with the help of Triggers. The Tasks in each Job automate scripts and eliminate human errors. Through various Tasks you can integrate different systems through file transfer, encryption, compression and transformation.
